parameters.query: WITH advanced AS (SELECT public.v3_advance_routing_tier($1::bigint,$2,NOW()) AS result) SELECT result,result->>'state' AS state,(result->>'opportunity_id')::bigint AS opportunity_id,NULLIF(result->>'attempt_id','')::bigint AS attempt_id,NULLIF(result->>'capture_event_id','')::bigint AS capture_event_id FROM advanced;

WITH ctx AS (SELECT NULLIF($1::text,'')::bigint AS attempt_id,$2::bigint AS opportunity_id,$3::text AS state,NULLIF($4::text,'')::bigint AS capture_event_id) SELECT jsonb_build_object('state',ctx.state,'opportunity_id',ctx.opportunity_id,'attempt_id',ctx.attempt_id,'capture_event_id',COALESCE(a.capture_event_id,ctx.capture_event_id)) AS result,ctx.state,ctx.opportunity_id,a.attempt_id,COALESCE(a.capture_event_id,ctx.capture_event_id) AS capture_event_id,a.routing_tier AS expected_tier,a.routing_tier,a.target_agent_id,a.target_number AS recipient_number,a.lease_token,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'property_title',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'property',''),NULLIF(c.current_property,''),NULLIF(o.property_id,''),'No disponible') AS property_title,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'operation_type',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'operation',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'listing_type',''),'No disponible') AS operation_type,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'property_zone',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'zone',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'address',''),'No disponible') AS property_zone,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'property_price',''),NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'price',''),'No disponible') AS property_price,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'lead_name',''),NULLIF(c.lead_name,''),'No disponible') AS lead_name,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.offer_context->>'lead_phone',''),NULLIF(c.lead_phone,''),NULLIF(o.e164_phone,''),'No disponible') AS lead_phone,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.property_public_id,''),NULLIF(o.property_id,''),'No disponible') AS property_public_id,e.offer_context->>'easybroker_url' AS easybroker_url,COALESCE(e.offer_context->'property_tags','[]'::jsonb) AS property_tags FROM ctx LEFT JOIN public.lead_routing_delivery_attempts a ON a.attempt_id=ctx.attempt_id AND a.opportunity_id=ctx.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN public.i24_capture_events e ON e.capture_event_id=COALESCE(a.capture_event_id,ctx.capture_event_id) LEFT JOIN public.lead_routing_opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id=ctx.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN public.conversations c ON c.conversation_id=o.conversation_id;

parameters.query:
WITH claimed AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.claim_unassigned_alerts(100, NOW(), INTERVAL '2 minutes')
)
SELECT claimed.*,
       (SELECT a.whatsapp_number FROM public.agents a WHERE a.agent_id = 'agent_manager') AS manager_phone,
       COALESCE(c.lead_name, 'Sin nombre') AS lead_name,
       COALESCE(c.lead_phone, o.e164_phone, 'N/D') AS lead_phone
FROM claimed
JOIN public.lead_routing_opportunities o USING (opportunity_id)
LEFT JOIN public.conversations c ON c.conversation_id = o.conversation_id;
